# Calendar view switching reads the visible old panel before changing visibility

currentView returns the first visible view-box child. The follow-up removes the tab loop's early hidden assignment, leaving the shared switch to read the old view, preserve its date/selection when active and then change visibility. The preceding tab loop could expose the target before that old-view lookup. Exact historical and accepted ordering support this dependency; a native refresh failure or complete accessibility result was not reproduced. This is scoped to these calendar receivers.

Scope: Calendar view selection ownership.
